outcome: introduction of complimentary feeds before 6 months
cohort: The study included 100 healthy, predominantly breastfed infants aged 0-6 months with normal birth weight and no history of illness or constipation.
finding: The prevalence of pseudo constipation in exclusively breastfed infants was 42%, and 64.3% of mothers of infants with pseudo constipation introduced complimentary foods before 6 months of age.
